sm.$description: Small breakpoint, 640 px: the owner kept Tailwind's step as final (ADR-0035, TBD-13). It is not a brand value.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint, 768 px, the middle reference viewport (A-09): the owner kept Tailwind's step as final (ADR-0035, TBD-13). It is not a brand value.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint, 1024 px: the owner kept Tailwind's step as final (ADR-0035, TBD-13). The site header shows its links in the bar from here. It is not a brand value.

xl.$description: Extra-large breakpoint, 1280 px, the widest reference viewport (A-09): the owner kept Tailwind's step as final (ADR-0035, TBD-13). It is not a brand value.

xxl.$description: Double-extra-large breakpoint, 1536 px: the owner kept Tailwind's step as final (ADR-0035, TBD-13). Named xxl because 2xl fails the REQ-017 AC2 naming pattern (ADR-0006 policy 6). It is not a brand value.

max.$description: Maximum content container width, 1280 px: the owner kept Nuxt UI's width as final (ADR-0035, TBD-13). It is not a brand value.
